title: Fur Friends ⚔️ Battle Edition Day 13 | Welcome to Pawlandia | Cozy Kawaii RPG Animation & Lofi
description:
A mysterious game pulls the Fur Friends into Pawlandia Online, a cozy fantasy MMORPG world! They choose their classes, take on their very first quest at Slime Meadow, level up together, and report back to the Adventurers' Guild... where a poster hints at a new friend.

0:00 A Mysterious Game
0:45 Choose Your Class
1:30 Slime Meadow
2:15 The Adventurers' Guild

⚔️ Battle Edition party: Momo the Assassin, Pipi the Tank, Otto the Healer and Kuku the Fighter. A new friend joins every episode!
🐾 No one gets hurt: bonked slimes just get dizzy, then become friends.
🎧 Best with headphones. Original lofi music & cozy fantasy sounds.
